}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Strings {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacons via dynamic string patterns in memory or files"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $cookie_hdr = "Cookie:" wide ascii
        $useragent_hdr = "User-Agent:" wide ascii
        $contentlen_hdr = "Content-Length:" wide ascii
        $gzip_accept = "gzip" wide ascii
        $keepalive = "Connection: keep-alive" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of ($http_*) and $cookie_hdr and $useragent_hdr
}
